summary: Polyrizon Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement entered into on September 3, 2026. The offerings involve 232,500 ordinary shares at $12.00 per share, 30,000 RDO pre-funded warrants, plus 70,833 PIPE pre-funded warrants and 333,333 ordinary share warrants, with aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $4.0 million. Exercise of warrants is subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. Expected closing is September 4, 2026. Net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes, operations, and potential acquisitions. Aegis Capital Corp. serves as placement agent. The transaction is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
